root_idea.summary: The root centers on going ahead: precedence in movement, order, attainment, or rank.
root_idea.development: From physical or temporal precedence it extends to racing and competition, priority in an affair, being foremost in merit, hastening toward an objective, and the stake awarded to a winner.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Form I verb is a distinct Quranic lexical form.
The Form III verb has a distinct reciprocal or competitive construction.
The Form VIII verb has distinct Quranic racing and hastening constructions.
The passive participle is presented under its singular citation form.
The active participle is a distinct Quranic nominal form.
The verbal noun is presented as its own Quranic form.
This is the feminine plural active participle and is covered under the normalized active-participle headword.

senses.definition: To precede, get ahead of, or outstrip another.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of being earlier or farther ahead in movement, order, or attainment; in negative contexts, it can mean to escape or elude being overtaken.

senses.definition: To precede in time or occurrence; to have already gone forth or been established.
senses.usage_conditions: Used especially of a decree, term, word, or prior event that has taken effect before another event; this is a temporal development of precedence rather than a racing sense.

senses.definition: To compete or strive with another to get ahead; to race one another toward a goal.
senses.usage_conditions: A reciprocal competitive construction, used literally of racing and figuratively of striving eagerly toward an objective.

senses.definition: To race or compete with one another to be ahead.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of people or parties contending to reach or obtain something first, including literal running or a contest.

senses.definition: To hasten or strive eagerly toward an objective.
senses.usage_conditions: In the construction استبق الخيرات, the competitive image is extended to earnest haste toward good deeds and other desirable aims.

senses.definition: To hasten along or get ahead to a route, with the resulting possibility of passing beyond it.
senses.usage_conditions: In the interpretation of 36:66, the expression can describe getting to or along the road and leaving it behind, hence losing the familiar way.

senses.definition: Outstripped, overtaken, or unable to elude another.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic negative construction, it denotes one who cannot escape being overtaken or brought within another's reach.

senses.definition: One who precedes, gets ahead, or outstrips; a forerunner.
senses.usage_conditions: The form can denote being ahead in an ordinary or comparative sense, including the inability of one body or party to outstrip another in a negative construction.

senses.definition: One who is foremost in merit and advances toward divine reward through righteous deeds.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative use of precedence for distinction and priority in good works; it is especially associated with those foremost in attaining reward and paradise.
In the Quranic oath construction, it denotes the act of going ahead or racing forward.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To anticipate mentally or preconceive something, sometimes leading to an error.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use in which the mind or supposition goes ahead of reflection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go or pass hastily to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with إِلَى to describe quick movement toward a person or party.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To proceed or come out before the expected time or before awareness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to speech that escapes prematurely, to vomit reaching the mouth before awareness, or to a pen that skips ahead while copying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To overcome or exceed another, including in generosity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَى or فِي for surpassing someone in a quality or achievement rather than merely arriving first.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Priority or precedence in undertaking an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal expression for being the first to apply oneself to or undertake a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or receive the stake in a race or shooting match, or to give that stake.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb is reported with two contrary valencies: receiving the wager and assigning or giving it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send horses or other competitors out to race and determine which will outstrip the others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of arranging or initiating a race, sometimes with the competitors' stakes in view.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a ewe or she-goat, to cast an incomplete fetus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare reported usage; the form with غ is stated to be better known for this meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a pair of jesses on a bird's legs and shackle it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized falconry construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hasten toward an affair or employ one's full force in getting to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported Form IV entry is used with إِلَى and is presented as a synonym of hastening or acting promptly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To compete or race with one another to gain precedence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of running, shooting, or striving toward any contested objective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lay wagers or stakes against one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A competitive extension of the reciprocal race construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For an event to happen or come quickly and beforehand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with إِلَى for something that comes to a person hastily or before he expected it; a Classical Arabic Form VIII construction distinct from the Quranic hastening and racing uses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A competitor who strives to precede or outstrip another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may be used collectively or in the plural for competing parties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stake or wager laid in a race or shooting match.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The successful competitor takes the stake; the term is also used for the property assigned as the prize.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A boy's daily lesson learned at school.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized educational usage, also called إِمَامٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A race or contest in running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal form associated with reciprocal competition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The preceding part of a discourse, together with its following context.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression سِبَاقُ الكَلَامِ وَسِيَاقُهُ, it denotes the preceding and following context of speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pair of jesses or shackles for a hawk or falcon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized falconry term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who habitually wins races or repeatedly obtains the prize.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the idiom سَبَّاقُ غَايَاتٍ for a frequent winner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse that outstrips the others in a race.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized racing use of the active participle, distinct from the Quranic figurative use of being foremost in merit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Palm trees that produce their fruit early.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or transferred plural use applied to palms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Priority or precedence in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun formed from the active participle for being first to undertake a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A predisposition to disease.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical medical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The state or condition of preceding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun describing precedence as a state or quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most preceding, prevenient, outgoing, or outstripping.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative form used in expressions comparing precedence or priority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse that is often or repeatedly outstripped.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized passive participial description in racing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The state or condition of being preceded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun corresponding to being overtaken or preceded.

cautions: The Quranic active participle in 79:4 has several reported referents, including angels, souls, horses, and stars; the public definition therefore preserves the common meaning of going ahead rather than selecting one referent.
The Form IV Lane entry is explicitly marked as possibly mistranscribed; its reported hastening meaning is retained only as a broader Classical Arabic meaning, not as a Quranic Form IV entry.
The public headwords normalize Quranic imperatives, inflected plurals, and feminine forms to standard dictionary citation forms.
